title: IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote attacker to execute…
description: IBM API Connect versions 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 contain a critical vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code. This is due to improper neutralization of special elements in operating system commands, leading to command injection risks.
